civilopediaText.text: A civic institution devoted to scholarship, debate, documentation, and preservation. The Athenaeum begins Ashton's institutional Knowledge economy.

civilopediaText.text: A professional military-learning institution for doctrine, intelligence, after-action analysis, wargaming, planning, and the preservation of lessons learned.

name: The Great Archive
uniques: Only available <if [University] is constructed in all [non-[Puppeted]] cities>
Cost increases by [15] per owned city
Destroyed when the city is captured

civilopediaText.text: A civilization-scale repository for scientific literature, engineering practice, doctrine, public records, standards, education, and institutional memory.
The Great Archive preserves what Ashton has learned so that future generations need not learn it again from nothing.
A Rationalist civic forum for education, reflection, public inquiry, ethical discussion, and the preservation of useful knowledge.
